turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, so let's not waste them. Why does my son have a zero?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
I didn't come for pleasantries. Owen saw that zero on his phone, in the middle of class. Who decided that, and did anyone speak to him first?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says not to use it as the sole basis for punishing a student. So what else do you have, or is that it?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.
"Quite reliable." Okay. Your own procedure, section 4.3, says software results don't establish a concern by themselves. Do you have anything else, or am I going to the principal?
So I had to give him a zero.
"Had to." Procedure 4.2 says you call the parent before any mark goes in. Nobody called me. So who decided, and what did you have in your hand when you did?
I hope you understand my position.
"I hope you understand." Okay. My position is that my son has a zero, nobody called me, and you still haven't told me what you had besides a score.
